title: WiMoT: Replay-Free Continual Wi-Fi Sensing via Moment Transport
abstract: arXiv:2610.32660v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual Wi-Fi sensing must balance plasticity, learning new rooms or users, against stability, keeping earlier ones, yet nodes often cannot retain channel state information (CSI) for privacy and storage reasons. We propose WiMoT (Wi-Fi Moment Transport), which stores the per-class feature mean and covariance of every earlier domain instead of samples. When the representation changes, stored statistics become stale. WiMoT restricts the change to an affine map on a frozen feature basis and applies the same map to the statistics, so they stay valid without old samples. Supervised contrastive learning learns the new domain, a closed-form loss on the stored statistics keeps earlier classes separable, and a Gaussian discriminant classifier, refitted from the transported statistics with equal weight per domain, predicts without domain identity. translated_title: WiMoT：基于矩传输的无重放持续Wi-Fi感知
translated_abstract: 持续Wi-Fi感知必须在可塑性（学习新房间或新用户）与稳定性（保留先前知识）之间取得平衡，然而出于隐私和存储方面的考虑，节点通常无法保留信道状态信息（CSI）。我们提出WiMoT（Wi-Fi矩传输），它存储每个先前域的各类别特征均值和协方差，而非原始样本。当特征表示发生变化时，存储的统计量会变得过时。WiMoT将这种变化限制在冻结特征基上的一个仿射映射，并将相同的映射应用于统计量，因此在没有旧样本的情况下也能保持统计量的有效性。该方法利用监督对比学习来学习新域，通过基于存储统计量的闭式损失保持先前类别的可分性，并使用从传输后统计量以每个域等权重重新拟合的高斯判别分类器进行预测，且无需域身份信息。在3DO、WiMANS和Widar3.0数据集上，WiMoT的平均最终准确率分别达到94.02%、89.61%和95.16%。
tldr: WiMoT通过存储并传输各类别特征的矩统计量（均值和协方差）而非原始样本，实现了无需重放旧数据的持续Wi-Fi感知，在保护隐私的同时兼顾了学习新域的可塑性与保留旧知识的稳定性。
